caption:
बॉयफ्रेंड और गॉसिप से हटकर देखिये बॉलीवुड की दो पीढ़ियों का यह बेहद खूबसूरत और दिल जीतने वाला अंदाज! 💃✨
शर्वरी ने हाल ही में इंस्टाग्राम पर एक वीडियो शेयर किया है जिसमें वह दिग्गज एक्ट्रेस माधुरी दीक्षित के साथ उनकी आने वाली फिल्म Yeh Prem Mol Liya के टाइटल ट्रैक पर थिरकती नजर आ रही हैं। 🎥
इस वीडियो के आखिर में शर्वरी अपने आइडल के सामने झुकती हैं और दोनों गले मिलती हैं, जिससे दो पीढ़ियों का यह प्यारा मिलन सोशल मीडिया पर छा गया है। 💖
फिल्म Yeh Prem Mol Liya को Sooraj Barjatya डायरेक्ट कर रहे हैं और इसमें शर्वरी के अपोजिट Ayushmann Khurrana नजर आएंगे, वहीं फिल्म Rajshri Productions और Mahaveer Jain Films के बैनर तले बन रही है। 🎬
शर्वरी का कहना है कि अपने आइडल के साथ डांस करना उनके लिए बेहद जादुई और सरियल अनुभव था, और उन्होंने माधुरी को OG Rajshri heroine बताया है। 🌟
इस फिल्म में Anupam Kher, Supriya Pathak, Seema Pahwa और Saumya Tandon भी अहम भूमिकाओं में हैं और यह फिल्म 27 November 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी। 🍿
तो दोस्तों, क्या आपको भी माधुरी और शर्वरी की ये जुगलबंदी पसंद आई या नहीं? नीचे कमेंट्स में फटाफट बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Sharvari dances with OG Rajshri heroine Madhuri Dixit to Yeh Prem Mol Liya song, calls it a ‘surreal’ moment with her idol
ctx.summary: Madhuri Dixit’s association with Sooraj Barjatya goes back to Hum Aapke Hain Koun, the 1994 blockbuster, starring alongside Salman Khan in the entertainer.
ctx.text:
Bollywood actor Sharvari got to live a fan moment she will remember for a long time. The actor recently danced with Madhuri Dixit to the title track of her upcoming film, Yeh Prem Mol Liya , and shared a video of their meeting on Instagram. The film stars Ayushmann Khurrana opposite Sharvari and is helmed by Sooraj Barjatya.
In the video, Sharvari begins dancing to the song before Madhuri joins her. The two share a few steps, and the clip ends with Sharvari bowing to the veteran actor before the two hug. The sweet interaction brings together two generations of actors connected to the Rajshri banner.
Sharvari shared her excitement in the caption, thanking Madhuri for the warmth and affection she showed her. She also referred to the actor as one of the original Rajshri heroines, recalling the legacy of the films she has been part of. Sharvari wrote, “So honoured to receive this much prem from one of the OG Rajshri heroines of Sooraj Barjatya sir.. the one and only Madhuri Dixit ma’am ♥️✨ Getting to dance alongside my idol feels surreal and soooo special 🥹😭♥️ Thankyou ma’am, you are the best! Hum Aapke Hain Kaun 🤝 #YehPremMolLiya In theatres 27th Nov 2026.”
Madhuri’s association with Sooraj Barjatya goes back to Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!, the 1994 blockbuster that became known for its songs, family celebrations and memorable performances. The film was led by her and Salman Khan along with Mohnish Bahl and Renuka Shahane in pivotal roles.
The dance video comes as the makers build excitement around the film’s music. Earlier this month, they released Jhumka Patola, a pre-wedding song sung by Shreya Ghoshal and composed by Himesh Reshammiya.
The actor opened up about her experience filming Jhumka Patola and how the director helped her connect with her character through the music. She said, “I’ve always loved dancing, but with Sooraj sir, a song is so deeply woven into the narrative that you can’t look at it as just a dance performance. While shooting ‘Jhumka Patola’, he would walk me through what the moment meant for my character and share stories from the songs he has made over the years, and I tried to carry that into every step and expression. Dance has its own language, and sometimes a song can say what a scene simply cannot.”
Yeh Prem Mol Liya is produced by Rajshri Productions in association with Mahaveer Jain Films. The film also features Anupam Kher, Supriya Pathak, Seema Pahwa and Saumya Tandon. It is scheduled to release in theatres on November 27, 2026.
